Repo copy of the coordinator seam decisions (`SD-nn`). This is `docs/build/decisions.md`. Group decision logs and layout notes that are not in this repo stay with the coordinator.

# Seam decisions for the builder briefs (fast mode, group A / WS-00 owner)

Written 2026-09-26 22:4x UTC in place of the reconciliation agent's `reconciliation-decisions.md`, which did not land. Authority: WS-00 (`docs/build/ws-00-skeleton-and-contracts.md`) unless a sibling brief measured something WS-00 did not; then WS-00 is amended and the sibling kept. Sources: `internal/build/reconciliation-queue.md` (all sections incl. the Modal GPU benchmark section of 22:28 UTC) and every `internal/build/layout-decisions-*.md`. Group A applies these to WS-00, WS-01, WS-02, WS-03, WS-11, WS-12 (log: `internal/build/decision-log-group-a.md`); group B applies the rows marked with its briefs (WS-04…WS-10, WS-13, WS-14). Numbers quoted are the measured ones from the source reports and are not rounded.

Each decision has an id `SD-nn`. "Amends WS-00" means the WS-00 brief is edited to carry it.

## 2. Stage graph and ids

| # | Decision | Applies to |
|---|---|---|
| SD-08 | `StageName` = 11 values: `validate, poses, objects, reads, scale, dense, coverage, scene, objects_3d, criteria, result`. Deps: `poses, objects, reads ← validate` (parallel); `scale ← poses, reads`; `dense ← poses, scale`; `coverage ← dense`; `scene ← coverage, objects(terminal)`; `objects_3d ← scene, objects` (optional, CPU, 120 s, WS-07); `criteria ← scene, reads(terminal), objects_3d(terminal)` after `merge_objects`; `result ← criteria`. Optional stages: `objects`, `reads`, `objects_3d`. `EarlyJobName = early_reads\|early_qa\|capture_check`. Amends WS-00 §3.9 and §3.12 (adds the `objects_3d` package `server/objects` sub-entry `run_3d`), the plan mermaid and WS-11 §9.5. | WS-00, WS-03, WS-06, WS-07, WS-09, WS-11 |
| SD-09 | Ids: `captureId = "cap_" + ULID`; `run_id = "run_" + sha256(packet.json bytes as stored)[:16]` (amendment runs hash the amendment packet); `confirmationId = "cfm_" + ULID`; `amendmentId` is the client's; events are keyed by `seq` (no `evt_` id). WS-00 D-09 amended. | WS-00, WS-01, WS-03 |
| SD-10 | Frame budget for SfM (Modal benchmark 22:28: L4 mapper 96 / 186 / 237 s at 40 / 60 / 70 photos, method 148 / 259 / 324 s; p50 3 min holds only near 40 frames): `poses` thins to `HSS_POSES_SFM_MAX_FRAMES=48` keyframes for the mapper and registers the rest as fixed-ARKit or through the image registrator; the stage timeout stays 420 s. | WS-03, WS-04, WS-11 |

## 7. Ingest, Modal, GCP, toolchain

| # | Decision | Applies to |
|---|---|---|
| SD-30 | Promotion (WS-01 W1-02/03): signed URLs write to `uploads/{cid}/{path}`; at acceptance + last commit every listed file is copied server-side to `captures/{cid}/{path}` with `if_generation_match`; `CommittedFile.key` tells early workers where bytes are readable now; pipeline stages read `captures/` only. | WS-00, WS-01, WS-02, WS-03, WS-12 |
| SD-31 | Modal WIF: pool per environment `modal-<env>`, provider `modal`, `google.subject = "modal/" + assertion.workspace_id + "/" + assertion.environment_name + "/" + assertion.app_name` (< 127 bytes; never `assertion.sub`), condition on `workspace_id` and `environment_name` only (app name not pinned: apps are composed with `app.include`); runtime SA `hss-runtime-<env>` with `workloadIdentityUser` and `serviceAccountTokenCreator` on itself; `GCP_WIF_AUDIENCE = //iam.googleapis.com/projects/<number>/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/modal-<env>/providers/modal`. Module interfaces are WS-01 §3.7 verbatim (`capture_bucket`, `modal_wif` with `project_number` input, bucket IAM via `object_admin_members`); WS-12's root stack calls them in every environment state and drops `create_pool`/`modal_app_name`. | WS-01, WS-12 |
| SD-32 | Modal app composition (WS-12's design, adopted): one `modal.App("house-scanning")` object in WS-00's `server/modal_app.py`, extended by WS-12 with `GPU_IMAGE` (from `Dockerfile`), `CPU_IMAGE`, `KNOBS` (deploy-time `HSS_PIPELINE_GPU`, `HSS_PIPELINE_MIN_CONTAINERS`, `HSS_PIPELINE_MAX_CONTAINERS`, `pipeline_timeout_s=1200`, `pipeline_scaledown_s=900`), `secrets_for(service)`, `smoke_cpu`, and at its bottom `app.include(api_app)` (WS-01's `server/api/modal_entry.py`) plus `import server.orchestrator.modal_functions` (WS-03 registers `Pipeline` with `warm`/`run_stage(run_id, stage, attempt)`, `coordinate_run`, `run_cpu_stage`, `early_reads`, `EarlyQa`, `capture_check`, `sweep` directly on that `app`; the import cycle is intentional and documented). WS-03 builds `Pipeline` (`cpu=8`, `memory=24576`, timeout 1200 s, `scaledown_window=900`); WS-12 deploys everything (`modal deploy -m server.modal_app`; WS-03's dev-only `-m server.orchestrator.modal_functions` deploys the same app name). `server/bench.py` is WS-12's own ephemeral `BenchRunner`, not a `Pipeline` method. Web endpoint label `capture-api` (URL `https://huntertcarver-<env>--capture-api.modal.run`); API function `timeout=120`, `max_containers=1` while `STATE_BACKEND=modal_dict`. `MODAL_APP_NAME=house-scanning` (Settings) is only for out-of-app lookups (`Cls.from_name`). Secrets: `hss-<env>-vlm` (`OPENAI_API_KEY`, `XAI_API_KEY`), `hss-<env>-api` (`CAPTURE_API_TOKENS`, `WEBHOOK_HMAC_SECRET`, `UPLOAD_URL_HMAC_SECRET`), `hss-<env>-gcp` (`GCP_*`, `GCS_BUCKET`, `STORAGE_BACKEND`, `STATE_BACKEND`, `STATE_DICT_NAME`), optional `hss-<env>-r2`; later `hss-<env>-db`, `hss-<env>-apns`. | WS-01, WS-03, WS-12 |
